title: Fluor Corporation 8-K — Completion of NuScale Share Sale
summary: Fluor Corporation filed an 8-K on April 23, 2026, announcing the completion of the sale of its remaining 40 million shares of NuScale Power Corporation, generating gross proceeds of $473 million. The corporation made a total investment of $570 million in NuScale and has generated approximately $2.43 billion in open market sales since September 2025.
key_points: Fluor Corporation completed the sale of 40 million remaining shares of NuScale Power Corporation on April 23, 2026
Gross proceeds from the share sale totaled $473 million
Total investment in NuScale was $570 million
Cumulative open market sales since September 2025 amount to approximately $2.43 billion
Signed by Kevin B. Hammonds, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary
